title: Channel Management Explained Simply | Marketing Management Ep 27
description:
Laddoo Lab now sells in ten local shops, a supermarket chain and its own online shop. Then one shopkeeper calls Arjun, angry: the online shop is cheaper than his shop. How do you keep every seller happy? In this animated lesson we use Laddoo Lab, a millet laddoo brand from Bengaluru, to understand channel management.

You will see Philip Kotler and Gary Armstrong's definition of marketing channel management, and a live run of Arjun's round: he selects 10 of 12 shops near schools, motivates them with a margin, a display stand and fresh packs every Monday, and evaluates them with a Saturday count that finds one hidden stand. Then we unpack channel conflict, vertical (between levels) and horizontal (at the same level), and watch Zoya fix the angry call with one price everywhere and nearby online orders sent to the local shop. We see selecting, motivating, evaluating and managing conflict at work today in a phone maker, a paint company, a medicine company and a car maker. We also look at the human side honestly: margins cost money and big buyers have big power, Nani refuses preservatives for the supermarket, and as Kotler notes, some conflict is healthy competition.

This is Episode 27 of our Marketing Management series for MBA, BBA and commerce students.
